title: the ticket-reader proof runs the host's bash on a posix path and names paths by Path, so its reader teeth pass on Windows
intention: test_the_ticket_is_three_files runs bin/cmd/whatsnext under shutil.which('bash') with a posix path, names the inbox source with Path(...).name, and looks the skill_block berth up as the reader resolved it, so reader_whatsnext, reader_inbox and reader_skill_block pass on Windows and are unchanged on POSIX.
why: Measured 2026-11-12 on akiendell: on Windows reader_whatsnext failed with /bin/bash: C:UsersakienAppData...: No such file, reader_inbox returned the Windows source path unsplit, reader_skill_block returned keys C:\\nowhere\\... that the slash literal missed; after the three edits those three pass and 1 of 45 teeth stays red (reader_ticket_inspector, a separate code bug)
traces_to: Law 3: green measured by running the edited proof (45 teeth, 3 fewer red); Law 8: reverting the edit reds all three ast teeth on Linux; Law 4: held by a scan.
how: In that proof change r_whatsnext's argv to [shutil.which('bash') or 'bash', (...).as_posix()], r_inbox's rsplit('/') to Path(...).name, and r_skill_block's `in repr(got)` to `str(Path('/nowhere/idea-berth.json').resolve()) in got`. Red-first proof cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_the_ticket_reader_proof_holds_on_windows.py holds all three with ast teeth that red on Linux.

clauses.claim: r_whatsnext runs the host's bash (shutil.which) on an as_posix script path, where it ran the bare word bash on a str(Path)
r_inbox names the source file with Path(...).name, where it split the string on a slash
r_skill_block looks the resolved berth key up in the dict, where it searched the repr of the dict

decisions.text: D2: one proof, one tooth per clause; red first.

measured.saw: on Windows reader_whatsnext failed with /bin/bash: C:UsersakienAppData...: No such file, reader_inbox returned the Windows source path unsplit, reader_skill_block returned keys C:\\nowhere\\... that the slash literal missed; after the three edits those three pass and 1 of 45 teeth stays red (reader_ticket_inspector, a separate code bug)
measured.how: cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_the_ticket_is_three_files.py run before and after the edits
